subcategory: Blue Flag Certified Tropical White Sand Shoreline
description: Voted the Best Beach in Asia by Time Magazine, a pristine two-kilometer curve of powder-white coral sand flanked by lush tropical mahua rainforests and crystalline turquoise waters on Swaraj Dweep.
why_visit: Walk barefoot on sugar-soft sand, swim in calm turquoise waters, watch glorious fiery sunsets over the Andaman Sea, and enjoy international-standard eco-certified facilities.
best_time_to_visit: October to May (Best sunset 4:45 PM - 5:30 PM)
activities: Swimming; Sunset Photography; Beach Combing; Tropical Forest Walking
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: 11 km from Havelock Jetty / 55 km catamaran ride from Port Blair
notes: Awarded prestigious Blue Flag certification; swimming permitted only until sunset.
